lifeCause.reason: Completed the agreed one-stay residence; independent person and property retained.

feature_objects.opening.value: Eda says a swollen joint drips onto her drying shelf. She offers a two-coin refundable knife deposit or a six-coin purchase. Bracing needs ordinary sound wood; an offered demonstration may reveal a more exact fitting method.

feature_objects.joint.value: Firsthand joint inspection: the cross-grain swollen stave leaks onto the one Village drying shelf. An ordinary brace can hold it clear while it still seeps; a matching sound-grain insert can seal this particular joint.

reference_gameplay.offer.value: After your firsthand joint inspection, Eda offers her measured-cooling bench: two stocked sleeves at two coins each, eight one-coin salt packets, a one-coin lesson, and up to three one-coin trials. Ordinary resin setting needs no method. Asking accepts no purchase, practice or debt.

reference_gameplay.buy_sleeve.value: You paid Eda 2 native coins for one actual sleeve. Her finite stock decreased and her purse received the payment. Purchase grants no cooling knowledge.

reference_gameplay.buy_salt.value: You paid Eda 1 native coin for one actual salt. Her finite stock decreased and her purse received the payment. Purchase grants no cooling knowledge.

missed.shower.value: The shower passed; the craftsman dried his bench. No missed reward is owed.

reference_gameplay.method.value: Eda taught you Measured cooling using your actual charged sleeve. You acquired the active source and method at mastery zero. Three paid supervised salt trials are needed for hook control; memory alone supplies neither tool nor charge.

reference_gameplay.practice.value: Eda supervised one paid measured-salt trial. Both people spent their own stamina, one salt packet was consumed and one coin entered Eda's purse. Your existing cooling mastery increased by one; no material product was made.

feature.battle.sluice.value: Nera holds a braced shield at the sluice; Oren carries a hooked pole and follows exposed frames. Their toll claim blocks the direct gate. A slower drainage walk remains open. They yield at one HP; no player level changes their bodies.

reference.coolingRefinement.failure.value: A paid three-minute cooling refinement completed as a failure. One actual salt packet and two stamina were spent. The accepted prepared quote was 70%, after 0 completed failed attempts; the one frozen roll was 0.956148. The completed failure adds one retry, capped at +15 percentage points, and five played minutes of soreness. No source, rank, application or quality bank was granted.

reference.coolingRefinement.success.value: A paid three-minute cooling refinement completed successfully. The accepted prepared quote was 75%, after 1 completed failed attempt; the one frozen roll was 0.144435. This earns one attributed steadied-hook application, with no rank, free source, sleeve or quality bank.

reference.coolingRefinement.steady_hook.value: You used your one attributed steadied-cooling application and an actual charged sleeve on Oren’s exposed hook grip. This paid field lasts five played minutes. It prevents the special hook pull while his owned pole remains equipped; ordinary jab and guard still work. The same empty sleeve returned to you.

feature.battle.result.value: Sluice result: withdrawn; 5 committed native actions, gate 0/3, escape 0/3, 1 guarded attempts. Spent materials, fatigue and wounds remain. Encounter receipt: simulation:4122.

reference_gameplay.hook.value: You used trained Measured cooling and a charged sleeve on Oren's actual exposed hook grip. The paid field lasts four played minutes. It prevents the special hook pull while his owned pole remains equipped; ordinary jab and guard still work.

workbench.value: Sound wood and counted fittings make a repeatable kit.

feature_objects.materialPurchase.value: Eda handed over one actual Sound repair stave for two coins. Her stock decreased by one; it does not replenish on revisit.

reference_gameplay.recharge.value: One actual salt packet and bench effort restored one empty sleeve to its charged variant. You kept the same owned sleeve; salt was consumed.

reference_gameplay.resin.value: You discharged one actual sleeve to set one Tree sap into one Set repair resin. The empty sleeve remains yours. No learned method or mastery was required.

repositories.opening.value: Miri offers to show you her sputtering lantern. She will arrange her own repair after eight played minutes. Silence accepts no work.

repositories.flare.value: You watched Miri use one owned resin pellet and relight the same wet lantern. Seeing this does not teach her practiced control.

repositories.wick_method.value: Miri corrected your wick pressure and resin seam. Seal one owned kit at first; three completed batches unlock a matched pair from one pellet. The method supplies no resin or extra body.

repositories.sealed_supplies.value: You sealed 2 real survey kits with owned resin. These supplies resist the floodline splash.

reference_gameplay.kits.value: You consumed one actual Set repair resin and two Sound repair staves to bind two native Prepared survey kits. Existing native preparation, trade and Eda's finite orders use these same kits.

feature_objects.purchase.value: You paid Eda six native coins for one actual sharp fitting knife from her finite stock. The tool is yours; the money is now hers.

feature_objects.cut.value: You cut one real Rough wood log into two Wet repair staves. The knife dulled; these pieces still need drying.

feature_objects.dry_shade.value: One Wet repair stave dried into one actual Sound repair stave in 6 played minutes. The covered ordinary rack worked without a repaired joint or method.

repositories.pump_offer.value: The floodline pump splashes directly onto a worker’s fittings. Miri offers protected repair or a surface bypass; after twelve played minutes she may fund her own bypass. An exposed kit will soak without fixing the pump.

repositories.pump_result.value: Your protected fittings survived the splash. The pump is restored; Miri can offer draws from its finite supply.

feature_society.meeting.value: Hessa keeps a household; Orr repairs locally; Vale is considering bounded teaching. Each has their own means and may refuse. Meeting them accepted no work.

feature_society.home.terms.value: Hessa offers two coins for two actual player-owned logs, three coins to Orr for one home repair, and two coins for one later apprentice shelf. Home access is limited to accepted repairs. No exclusive service or affection is bought.

feature_society.home.supply.value: Transferred two real logs to Hessa. Her reserved two coins paid the player. No replacement logs or wage were created.

feature_society.home.agreement.value: Witnessed the agreed limited repair right. No wage or result has been awarded; Orr must perform the funded work.

feature_society.home.report.value: At an actual later meeting, Hessa showed the completed home repair. Two supplied logs became the retained fixture; Orr earned the actual three-coin wage. This report does not expose Orr’s purse or future plans.

feature_society.apprentice.request.value: Offered Vale one lesson, an owned kit, two consumable coins and one separately paid household shelf. Vale has not yet answered. Future management and bench rights are separate offers.

feature_society.apprentice.answer.value: At this meeting Vale accepted only the bounded lesson and one funded shelf. Their future autonomy and earned wages remain theirs.

feature_society.apprentice.lessonTerms.value: Paid Orr one actual coin for the agreed lesson. Orr and Vale will use their own attention/body at a free bench. Payment grants no competence, affection or future labor.

feature_society.apprentice.lessonReport.value: At this later meeting Vale reported their completed lesson and zero initial mastery. Teaching is distinct from owned tools, permitted work and wages.

audit_remainder.terms.value: You deliberately opened the additional local project and commission choices. Each invitation, construction, lesson, stocked offer, preparation and challenge still needs its own current terms, means and commitment. This reading grants no person, material, power, payment or obligation.

remainder_livelihood.allocation.terms.value: The present craftsman permits one new finite commission at his actual Village bench. Choose Orr’s ordinary kit production or Vale’s learned bench drying, or keep your kit for your own work. Sponsorship transfers one actual player-owned unencumbered kit, one log and two native coins to the chosen worker’s stock and separate work purse; Vale additionally needs one actual Tree sap. The worker independently reserves their own learned join, counted kit, one attention, two stamina and five played minutes during 08:00–18:00. One funded coin becomes consumable fittings and one becomes their earned wage on completion. Orr’s one new kit stays theirs until separate collection; their original sponsored tool returns exactly once and stays theirs. Vale consumes the log and sap to dry only this current wet Village bench, enabling its existing ordinary harness work until another authored wetting. Both jobs contend for the same one commission claim and actual one-capacity bench. Cancelled/lost-support work refunds exact reservations to its worker; a separate pre-result withdrawal returns all supplied stock and funded coins. No competence, attention, stock or permanent weather immunity is granted.

remainder_livelihood.allocation_orr.fund.value: Supplied Orr with 1 real log, one actual kit transferred into their ownership. Two native coins moved into their separate work purse and one finite player commission became available. No kit output, earned wage or acquired operation was awarded. The independent worker must reserve and complete the supported local job.

remainder_livelihood.allocation_orr.with.value: Withdrew the unfinished sponsorship after any live reservation ended. The worker returned exactly the supplied material stock and two unchanged funded coins. Their original equipment, attention, private funds and prior lawful results stay theirs. This finite commission is now closed and cannot be funded again.

remainder_home.terms.value: Eda permits one timber rain cover over the outer measuring strip of her real Village fitting-bench site. Two supplied logs, two coins, two stamina and five played minutes build it. The cover permits only the newly offered offcut-trimming job during actual rain; the old dry rack, shelf, recipes and regional weather keep their existing rules. Your own completed cutting and drying observations can support paid measuring research. One separate specialization requires actual recovered conditioning and an ordinary loaded-frame trial.

remainder_home.cover.value: Two actual logs became a stationary cover over Eda's permitted outer measuring strip. Two native coins entered her purse. This particular new trimming job can now continue during actual rain; no other job, wet wood or regional weather changed.

remainder_home.trim.value: One real Rough wood log was divided into one Wet repair stave and two Green repair offcuts. Your owned sharp fitting knife became its dulled variant and stayed yours. These three counted green pieces account for the timber; none is sound or dry yet. The reusable measuring jig was not supplied.

remainder_home.dry_offcuts.value: Two actual Green repair offcuts from the disclosed local trimming stock dried into two Compatible repair offcuts over six played minutes. No piece was duplicated and no jig or fitting knowledge was awarded.

remainder_home.research.value: Eda reconciled my own committed cutting result and separate committed wet-to-sound drying result. I understood the matching-width measurement used by one local salvage recipe. Two real coins paid her, and both of us spent effort and four played minutes. Reading this report supplies no wood, physical jig, source or salvage output.

remainder_home.jig.value: One actual log and one sap became one owned Reusable measuring jig after three played minutes and one stamina. The paid research gave the recipe; this separate construction supplied the tool. No offcut or stave was granted.

remainder_home.salvage_ordinary.value: Two counted Compatible repair offcuts became one actual Sound repair stave in 4 played minutes. Your owned measuring jig was reserved and returned exactly once. Ordinary measured fitting remains available without either specialization. The sound stave can supply the existing brace, grain matching or kit recipes.

remainder_home.room_terms.value: I authorize one guest room inside my actually assembled, player-owned field-workshop site at the native Shack. Two staged phases consume two logs, four construction coins, seven played minutes and three stamina; a counted kit is held and returned in finishing. Only the finished room grants one residence claim. A later one-time willing invitation requires a separate real kit, log and two-coin starter purse. No automatic rent, food drain or supply refill is created.

remainder_home.room_frame.value: One supplied Rough wood log and two paid construction coins became the guest-room frame inside your earned Shack field-workshop site. Four played minutes and one stamina were spent. A frame grants no residence slot or resident.

remainder_home.room_finished.value: The second real log and two construction coins finished one guest room at your earned Shack field workshop. Your counted kit was returned once. The completed room grants exactly one unoccupied residence claim; it grants no person, wood, kit, wage or service. No dismantling action is offered, and occupancy must end before any later removal design.

remainder_home.resident_terms.value: Neri is an independent willing local kit binder with her own body, learned operation and finite attention. Meeting her supplies no tool, wage, residence or result. Invite supplies one actual kit, one log and two native coins to her own stock/purse. She independently accepts supported terms, occupies the one room and performs at most one material service. One coin pays her fittings expense; one remains hers. One produced kit may be collected after her actual job. Decline is free; departure ends future offers while retaining her identity and earned property.

remainder_home.invitation.value: I transferred one actual kit, one log and two native coins to Neri's separate stock and purse under her one-stay terms. This is a supplied invitation, not an immediate occupant or finished service. Her own controller must still accept with the completed vacant room, current willingness and living supported body. The supplies are hers; meeting or rendering cannot refill them.

remainder_home.resident_report.value: I met Neri at the real Shack room. Arrival, occupancy, her funded work and collection are separate commitments. Her completed public work is available through its own known collection control; this meeting grants no stock, occupation or wage.

remainder_home.collected.value: Neri transferred the one actual Prepared survey kit produced by her completed paid service. Her returned tool kit, unspent coin, body and previous work remain hers. This kit supports the existing native field preparation, packing, orders and trade; collection cannot repeat.

remainder_home.departure.value: We ended the one stay after all Neri's reservations had ended. Her occupancy claim returned to me; her stable departed person, actual tool, purse and prior results remain retained. The one invitation cannot respawn her or fund another stay. Any uncollected product remains hers, and no new room removal action is granted.

home_furnishings.survey.value: You paid two construction coins and physically surveyed your own completed Shack field workshop using your real kit. Three played minutes and one stamina registered permission for one ventilated drying rack and one fixed-stop drafting bench. Each fixture still needs its supplied physical phases. This opt-in has no automatic upkeep, dismantling, housing, resident, source, casting, fuel or free material. The existing guest room, Neri's occupation/service and old facilities retain their own claims and rules.

home_furnishings.rack_frame.value: Two actual Rough wood logs became the drying-rack uprights and rails inside your earned Shack workshop. Your kit was held and returned once; four played minutes and two stamina were spent. A frame cannot dry stock. No room, resident, source or material was granted.

home_furnishings.rack_finished.value: One further real log and one Tree sap became the spaced drying rails. The kit returned once after three played minutes and one stamina. This stationary fixture permits only the new four-minute two-offcut drying job in this workshop. It supplies no stock and changes no old rack, weather, room or residence rule.

party.lio.value: Lio offers braced support for an agreed contest. He reports 28 HP, 12 stamina and four guard efforts, and offers to keep his condition visible during this agreed contest. He uses his own harness and trained control; he will stop when exhausted or wounded.

book.mol.chart.value: Original voluntary Cyoria visitor branch: keep your living native human body, owned cargo and learned history. Entry supplies disclosed language contact and a return doorway, no mage source, licence, student status, another person’s memories, private mind access or future knowledge. One local academy/household/service arc uses frozen unsupported absence; this place never resets. Personal mana compatibility must be assessed, not assumed; this contract gives no reset ability. Paid specialists and finite device charge offer a useful non-mage route.

book.mol.enrollment.value: Chose original independent retained-body guest entry. Cyoria’s sourced academy/household/magic distinctions support this finite branch; early Kael access and non-mage manual lamp interface are explicit authored divergences. Your body received no magical talent, private cast knowledge, source-protagonist memories or time powers.

book.mol.arrival.value: Cyoria has a station, academy, workshops, library and mana well. Its trains use crystallized-mana engines while passenger-shaping wards inhibit casting. Your original arrival point is a separate doorway: you may walk to the guest desk or Imaya’s household without using any spell. No guest housing or academy admission is yet granted.

book.mol.house.value: Imaya offers a small paid guest arrangement and one finite original household job. She keeps her rooms and family privacy. Food, damage, chores and consent matter; helping does not make this your property.

book.mol.houseWage.value: Completed the paired kitchen sorting and received eight Imaya-owned crowns and one actual bread parcel. The shift supplies no magical skill or recurring stipend.

book.mol.kael.value: Kael is a scholarship-supported healer/alchemist caring for Kana. He offers one finite material sorting job and can examine a sealed local residue sample for two crowns. He shares a mild salve procedure, not his daughter’s affairs, full research corpus or a cure for the Weeping.

book.mol.kaelWork.value: Kael paid eight of his existing crowns and supplied one paper for a completed label-sorting agreement. Restricted compounds and private memories were not opened. His remaining purse, supplies, attention and family duty still limit later help.

book.mol.admission.value: Ilsa distinguishes guest reading, mage certification, commercial practice and student mentorship. She offers one original guest pass for two local crowns and clerical work. It opens only the represented public guest reading shelf and supervised workshop, not restricted person-targeting instruction or student privileges.

book.mol.guestRights.value: Ilsa issued the actual physical guest pass. Your limited permission is reading and supervised reconstruction; it is no first-circle badge, admission to the academy, authority to unlock property, or permission to sell magic.

book.mol.assessment.value: The original retained-body assessment demonstrated no compatible personal Cyorian mana source. This limited negative result does not prove permanent incapacity or grant a source. Capacity training, raw ambient channeling, rods requiring personal mana and restricted spell lessons remain unavailable. The manual device route uses Nora’s separately attuned stored charge. Its fixed six-unit capacity is equipment, not your soul magnitude. The non-mage manual interface is an original engineered divergence; sourced formula rods still require personal channeling.

book.mol.library.value: Ibery checks your physical pass and offers a finite catalog repair funded by her own purse/materials. The academy library holds broad mundane and magical knowledge; limited guest access does not expose every tunnel or restricted spell shelf.

book.mol.catalog.value: You repaired the bounded public-shelf catalogue and received twelve existing crowns plus one research paper. No mind-based automated library search or spell knowledge was conferred.

book.mol.invocation.value: A structured invocation creates a bounded mana construct; unstructured shaping is slower and difficult. Disrupting levitation can drop its load. Ignition leaves ordinary burning fuel, which dispelling does not extinguish. Reading these distinctions grants knowledge only, no personal fuel, spell or practice.

book.mol.formula.value: Nora’s source lesson requires reconstruction of a keyed stone-cube lamp with command recognition, three brightness levels and occlusion shutoff. Formulas stabilize anchored spells; ink and a design alone do not cast. This original manual-interface variant narrows the task for your non-mage body: Nora anchors the spell, you operate prepared controls. It cannot attack, drain ambient mana automatically, or function outside Cyoria.

book.mol.charge1.value: Nora spent six of her own finite attuned mana to calibrate your empty six-unit device. This is transferred bounded equipment charge, not player casting fuel; no timer, mana well or rendering refills it. Each calibration is a finite consenting job.

book.mol.retrievalTerms.value: Taiven offers a bounded original hatch retrieval based on the source’s paid lost-watch sewer work: one watch, no tunnel clearing, six client-funded crowns on actual handover. An oil-residue smell and unseen occupants make a rush unsafe. The stated window is90local played minutes from this offer, not a source festival conversion. Survey, tether and willing cover are alternatives. You can decline or miss the window.

book.mol.fieldSurvey.value: From the open hatch you recorded oily residue, movement beyond the grate and one sealed residue sample. Identity, intelligence and full tunnel numbers remain unknown. The limited sightline supports a tethered short reach; it grants no mind reading or knowledge of a future invasion.

book.mol.fieldOutcome.value: You declined the bounded retrieval. No watch, payout, injury or tunnel clearance was granted. Your guest rights, paid study, household ties and actual notes remain useful.

book.mol.closure.value: Your actual recovery/payment, decline, withdrawal, late account or failed attempt closes the bounded service arc. Imaya’s household remains occupied; the changed hatch hazard, consumed means, injuries, guest rights, permitted research and source cast stay in this retained instance. This is a completed local service account; unobserved city-wide futures remain unknown.

book.mol.lamp.value: Your actual cube and ink became one keyed lamp after supervised reconstruction and Nora’s two own attuned mana. Its stored reserve is empty; paid calibration still supplies charge. You learned your own manual control procedure at zero mastery, not Nora’s formula knowledge, talent or personal capacity.

reference_gameplay.offer_record.value: I offered my existing local cooling skill, two sleeves and eight measured salt packets after the traveler inspected the joint. These finite supplies will not renew on return.

reference_gameplay.lesson.value: I completed the traveler's paid cooling lesson using our own attention and stamina. The one native coin entered my purse. I promised no future free trials.

remainder_home.permission.value: I permit the traveler to build one cover on my outer measuring strip and do the disclosed new trimming and measuring work here. My existing shelf, recipes, stock and ownership remain separate. Cover payment is two coins only at actual completion.

remainder_home.cover_witness.value: I completed the paid two-log cover at my Village bench. I still own the site and permit the traveler's disclosed independent strip work.

remainder_home.research_witness.value: I completed the paid measurement study with the traveler's actual firsthand cutting and drying records. I supplied instruction and spent my own effort; no physical jig was gifted.

repositories.wick_method.value: I know how resin and wick pressure restore my lantern.

repositories.own_repair.value: My lantern now burns steadily. The resin and effort came from actual supplies.

feature_society.home.supply.value: Bought two real logs from the player for two of my eight coins.

feature_society.home.result.value: Orr performed my agreed repair with the actual two logs and returned their kit. Paid three of my own coins. My home is now repaired.
Consumed Hessa’s two reserved logs into her retained repair. Her three reserved coins paid my purse. Returned my counted kit. One demand, attention and body time were spent.

feature_society.apprentice.teaching.value: Completed the consented lesson with our own body/attention. Vale acquired their own trained operation; none of the player’s or my mature competence was copied.

remainder_livelihood.allocation_orr.fund.value: Received this one finite commission, actual supplied stock and two real coins in my separate work purse. Funding grants me no competence or replenished attention. My accepted work and eventual earned purse remain my own.

feature_society.apprentice.answer.value: I choose one bounded lesson and shelf. I reserve the right to stop future offers, keep my own earned wages and decide on a later handoff.

feature_society.apprentice.method.value: Learned my own ordinary sound-join operation from Orr. My mastery begins at zero. I still need an actual kit, wood, body, funds and permission.

remainder_home.resident_method.value: I learned ordinary kit binding through my earlier local work. I arrive with my own living two-handed body and finite attention, but no timber, kit or purse. remainder_home.acceptance.value: I choose the one funded stay in the actual completed vacant Shack room. Its unique residence claim now records my occupancy. I own the supplied kit, log and purse. I will decide on my own one supported binding service; arrival produces no material.

remainder_home.service.value: I spent my supplied log, one actual purse coin for fittings, two of my stamina, one attention and five played minutes to make one new Prepared survey kit. My counted tool kit returned exactly once and stays mine. I retain my remaining coin. The new product belongs to me until the disclosed collection transfer; no second service is promised.

book.mol.private.retrieval.value: I seek a bounded local watch retrieval and keep my actual staff, training, food, rope, client purse and own mana. I know no visitor observations until they are actually delivered. This branch has no confirmed festival forecast or reset.

book.mol.private.workshop.value: I teach functional formula reconstruction and own the represented workshop materials, attention and attuned reserve. A guest receives only agreed supervised information and equipment. Reading a formula is not casting or licensed sale.
